text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it's almost time to head back.
Let's go,
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, sorry! I'm comi—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Owww...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've been wincing and groaning all
day. Did
you hurt yourself somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, it's nothing that serious! My
joints just
feel a little creaky, is all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not "nothing," Flower. Shouldn't
you get
that looked at?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Or at least talk to your trainer about it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, we're both doing our best
and
staying positive right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and I are both confident I'll run
well in the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And... I don't want to burst our bubble,
you
know?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring it up if my joints really start
hurting, of
course! But right now, I'm
fine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... When something hurts, you
should just say
so.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But here, I'll do you a special favor and
cast a
spell on you—one that'll have you
feeling better
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sweet Pea... Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a busy day of training in the lead-up
to the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: N-no... Let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We carry on with the training session,
but
something about Nishino Flower's
movements
seem stiff.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was tough.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I feel perfectly fine!
choice_data_list: Does anything feel off with your body?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm just, uh... a little bit tired...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What?! N-no, I'm fine! I can keep
training.
choice_data_list: Then let's call it a day after this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, I...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. I'm gonna go get changed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something's definitely up with Nishino
Flower, but if she doesn't want to tell
me, pressuring her
about it might only
have the opposite effect.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, her body is already in a state of
flux.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This may not be a bad thing. I'll just
have to keep
a closer eye than usual on
her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I... told a lie.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sorry,
Trainer. But I'm really okay. I
just don't
want you to worry...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I am okay, right? I hope this doesn't get any worse...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Is my body breaking down because I
lied to
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm fine...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower still looks upset even
during our
next training session.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fine!
choice_data_list: Isn't your body still feeling worn...
Aren't you still feeling worn out?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, s-sorry... I, uh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go run now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I knew it. Something really is wrong... My legs won't move like I want them to!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(No, I'm just imagining things! There's no
way my body can change that fast. It
can't just suddenly
give up on me or
anything...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm fine... I'm fine! As long as I
concentrate as I
run, everything will be
fine!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's start is a little
awkward. She
gradually slows down before finally
coming to a
stop.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I lied! I'm not okay at all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My legs won't move properly... They
don't feel
the same as they did before...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I'm doomed!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm... so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't... run anymore!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower starts bawling her eyes
out. It
breaks my already anxious heart.
But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hearing what she said, I'm
convinced. Right
now, she's standing at
the crossroads of change.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sob... Sniffle... Hic!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Okay...
choice_data_list: Let's go have the doctor take a lo...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. You're going through a
growth spurt.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A growth spurt?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even though you're race-ready,
you're still younger than the other
students because you
skipped grades, so
your body was less mature.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
But now, your physique is finally
catching up to
the others.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be just like them? Does that mean my
joint
pain is...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Simply regular growing pains. My
examination
didn't reveal anything you
should worry about.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It's proof that your body is changing and
growing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm... growing?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You are! Congratulations,
Nishino
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so glad! What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I... I thought my body was breaking
down because
I lied to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, but still...
choice_data_list: You didn't want to make us worry, ...
You didn't want to make us worry, ...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thank you!
choice_data_list: I'll never let you fall apart, I p...
I'll never let you ruin yourself, ...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It seems your trainer has grown a
lot over
these past two years as well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's right! My trainer's the best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower's growth spurt
begins!
